extraMeanings.en: a piece of music performed by one person
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She played a beautiful guitar solo during the concert.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Konser sırasında güzel bir gitar solosu çaldı.

extraMeanings.en: a period of time or the width of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The project was completed within a span of two years.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Proje iki yıllık bir süre içinde tamamlandı.

extraMeanings.en: to save someone from having to experience something unpleasant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'll spare you the boring details of the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Seni toplantının sıkıcı ayrıntılarından esirgeyeceğim.

extraMeanings.en: to give time or money that you can afford
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bana yardım etmek için birkaç dakika ayırabilir misin?

extraMeanings.en: to cause something to start or happen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new law sparked a wave of protests across the country.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa ülke genelinde bir protesto dalgasını tetikledi.

extraMeanings.en: to make thread or a web by twisting fibres
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The spider spins a web to catch insects.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Örümcek böcekleri yakalamak için ağ örer.

extraMeanings.tr: su birikintisi, sıçrayan sıvı; ışık/renk lekesi
extraMeanings.en: a small amount of liquid or a bright patch of colour
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a splash of red paint on the wall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duvarda bir kırmızı boya lekesi vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to force liquid out in small drops over an area
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She sprayed perfume on her wrists before leaving.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çıkmadan önce bileklerine parfüm sıktı.

extraMeanings.en: to crush something or press it into a smaller space
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He squashed the empty can with his foot.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Boş kutuyu ayağıyla ezdi.

extraMeanings.en: to fit into a small space with difficulty
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We managed to squeeze into the crowded elevator.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık asansöre zar zor sığmayı başardık.

extraMeanings.en: an attempt to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I've never cooked this before, but I'll have a stab at it.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bunu daha önce hiç pişirmedim ama bir deneyeceğim.

extraMeanings.en: to arrange things in a pile
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please stack the chairs against the wall after the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan sonra lütfen sandalyeleri duvara dayayıp istifleyin.

extraMeanings.en: a large amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I've got stacks of work to finish before Friday.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cumaya kadar bitirmem gereken bir sürü işim var.

extraMeanings.en: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He staggered home after the long, exhausting journey.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzun ve yorucu yolculuktan sonra sendeleyerek eve gitti.

extraMeanings.en: to shock or amaze someone greatly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The size of the debt staggered the whole team.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Borcun büyüklüğü tüm ekibi hayrete düşürdü.

extraMeanings.en: to leave a mark that is difficult to remove
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The red wine stained the white tablecloth.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kırmızı şarap beyaz masa örtüsünü lekeledi.

extraMeanings.en: a strong pointed stick pushed into the ground
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They drove a wooden stake into the ground to mark the spot.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeri işaretlemek için toprağa tahta bir kazık çaktılar.

extraMeanings.en: the main stem of a plant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She cut the flower with a long stalk.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzun saplı çiçeği kesti.

extraMeanings.en: a level of quality that is considered acceptable
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The hotel maintains a very high standard of service.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otel çok yüksek bir hizmet standardını korur.

extraMeanings.en: to say or write something clearly and formally
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please state your name and address on the form.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen formda adınızı ve adresinizi belirtin.

extraMeanings.en: the condition that someone or something is in
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car was in a terrible state after the accident.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba kazadan sonra berbat bir durumdaydı.

extraMeanings.en: noise on a radio or TV, or electricity that builds up
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was too much static on the radio to hear the news.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Radyoda haberleri duyamayacak kadar çok parazit vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to guide someone or something in a particular direction
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The teacher tried to steer the discussion back to the main topic.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen tartışmayı ana konuya geri yönlendirmeye çalıştı.

extraMeanings.tr: ağır ağır pişirmek, yahni yapmak; kaygıdan içi içini yemek
extraMeanings.en: to cook slowly in liquid, or to worry about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Let the meat stew for two hours until it is tender.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eti yumuşayana kadar iki saat ağır ağır pişir.

extraMeanings.en: to attach or become fixed to something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The stamp wouldn't stick to the envelope.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Pul zarfa yapışmıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to put something somewhere, often casually
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Just stick your coat on the chair.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ceketini sandalyeye bırakıver.

extraMeanings.en: painful and difficult to move (of muscles or joints)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My neck feels stiff after sleeping in a strange position.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tuhaf bir pozisyonda uyuduktan sonra boynum tutuldu.

extraMeanings.en: formal and not relaxed or friendly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: His manner was rather stiff and unfriendly.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tavrı oldukça soğuk ve mesafeliydi.

extraMeanings.tr: berbat olmak, iğrenç olmak, hoş olmamak
extraMeanings.en: to be very bad or unpleasant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The whole plan stinks and I don't want to be part of it.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bütün plan berbat ve ben bunun parçası olmak istemiyorum.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden sharp pain in the side of the body
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I got a stitch in my side halfway through the run.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Koşunun ortasında böğrüme bir ağrı saplandı.

extraMeanings.en: to move your hand gently over a surface
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gently stroked the cat's soft fur.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kedinin yumuşak tüylerini nazikçe okşadı.

extraMeanings.en: a single movement, hit, or mark
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He painted the wall with long, even strokes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duvarı uzun ve düzgün fırça darbeleriyle boyadı.

extraMeanings.en: to stop something from growing or developing properly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Poor nutrition can stunt a child's growth.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kötü beslenme bir çocuğun büyümesini engelleyebilir.
